title: Rice-VL: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Cultural Understanding Across ASEAN Countries
reasoning: The RICE-VL benchmark specifically includes 'Religious Practices' and 'Places of Worship' as two of its primary cultural domains. It evaluates models on their ability to identify and reason about religious artifacts, temple structures (e.g., Sri Mariamman Temple), and spiritual traditions (e.g., Morning Alm Rounds) in the Southeast Asian context.
